name: Allgauer Brauhaus AG
summary: Allgäuer Brauhaus AG produces, sells, and markets beers and non-alcoholic drinks in Germany. The company sells beverages under the Allgäuer Brauhaus label name. The company was founded in 1911 and is based in Kempten, Germany. Allgäuer Brauhaus AG is a subsidiary of Mainzer Aktien-Bierbrauerei AG.
